Updated on Apr 27, 2026 Advertising of baby formula and feeding accessories is permitted only in countries where local laws and regulations allow such advertising. Ad content must not discourage breastfeeding or encourage formula use as a substitution for breastfeeding. Advertisers are responsible for following all country-specific laws and regulations, including relevant disclaimers as mandated by locale laws. Infant formula is defined as formula intended for infants between 0 and 12 months in Australia, Belgium, Mexico, and Singapore and South Africa and between 0 and 6 months in other locales. Follow on formula is defined as formula intended for infants older than 12 months in Australia, Belgium, Mexico, and Singapore and between 6 and 12 months in other locales. Supply-specific restrictions Ads for formula and feeding products are prohibited globally on Homepage and Fire Devices supply.
